title: Scenario To Platform
source_docs: Sensor Fusion and Tracking Toolbox/Tracking Scenario and Sensor Models/Scenario_To_Platform.md
text: Transform platform poses from scenario frame to platform body frame, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Reference platform index}, {Enable reference platform pose input}, {Source of output bus name}, {Specify an output bus name} sets the output port bus and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
